text: Are you bothered that I can so easily manipulate you?

text: Don't push me, Sheldon. I may be small, but I took kung fu when I was thirteen and I remember a good deal of it.

text: Oh, really? Well, I grew up with an older brother and a very contentious twin sister, and I believe I could easily best you in any physical confrontation, be it noogies, swirlies, or the classic why are you hitting yourself?

text: Ooh, big talk from a man who was once treed by a chicken.

text: Why would you buy peppermint schnapps?
